newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek sees FIM 53 mln gain in court case.
newsitem.headline: Partek sees FIM 53 mln gain in court case.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and building materials group Oy Partek Ab said on Thursday it stood to gain 53.2 million markka from a turnover tax dispute that a high court had ruled in its favour.
"Partek's result (is) to improve by 53.2 million markka," Partek said in a statement.
The court ruled that the transfer prices used in association with the incorporation of Partek's operations in 1991 had been justified and correct, Partek said.
As a result of the ruling, the punitive tax increases and additional taxes assessed by the tax authorities would be cancelled immediately, it said.
"Partek has ... made provisions for 53.2 million markka, so the cancellation of the tax will improve the comany's result for the year by an equivalent amount," it said.
